decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection unit builds directly on existing fluid metering and mechanical engineering knowledge, enabling assimilation of market feedback.
Similar to Product A, it leverages core fluid handling and machinery capabilities for learning and improvement.
Automatic airless spray gun extends the firm's mechanical spray equipment expertise, though automation adds some control complexity.
Manual airless spray gun is a core product closely aligned with existing spray equipment knowledge, allowing clear interpretation of results.
Air-assisted airless spray gun remains within the firm's established fluid application technology, supporting learning and incremental improvement.
Data logger for coating equipment requires electronics and software knowledge distant from the firm's mechanical core, lowering absorptive capacity and ability to improve based on early results.
